<issue>
XML serialization broken for Garmin extensions and XML special characters

When using GPXExtensionsField to serialize XML with Garmin extensions or XML containing special characters, the output is incorrect. This appears to be a regression in the latest version.

Minimal example to reproduce with Garmin extensions:

```python
import gpxpy
import gpxpy.gpx

# Create a GPX object with Garmin extensions
gpx = gpxpy.gpx.GPX()
gpx_track = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrack()
gpx.tracks.append(gpx_track)
gpx_segment = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrackSegment()
gpx_track.segments.append(gpx_segment)

# Add a point with Garmin extension
point = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrackPoint(latitude=12.3, longitude=45.6)
point.extensions = """
<gpxtpx:TrackPointExtension xmlns:gpxtpx="http://www.garmin.com/xmlschemas/TrackPointExtension/v1">
  <gpxtpx:hr>100</gpxtpx:hr>
</gpxtpx:TrackPointExtension>
"""
gpx_segment.points.append(point)

# This will fail to correctly serialize the extensions
xml = gpx.to_xml()
print(xml)
```

Also, when using XML with special characters in extensions, the serialization fails:

```python
import gpxpy
import gpxpy.gpx

gpx = gpxpy.gpx.GPX()
gpx_track = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrack()
gpx.tracks.append(gpx_track)
gpx_segment = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrackSegment()
gpx_track.segments.append(gpx_segment)

# Add a point with extension containing special characters
point = gpxpy.gpx.GPXTrackPoint(latitude=12.3, longitude=45.6)
point.extensions = """
<custom:data xmlns:custom="http://example.com/custom">
  <custom:value>Special chars: < > & "</custom:value>
</custom:data>
"""
gpx_segment.points.append(point)

# This will fail to correctly encode the special characters
xml = gpx.to_xml()
print(xml)
```

The issue appears to be in the `_ETree_to_xml` method in `gpxfield.py`.
</issue>
